name: Corner Trap
idea: When the dribbler goes into the corner, two defenders trap them, and the sideline and baseline do the rest.
why: In the corner, the sideline and the baseline work like two more defenders: the dribbler can't step out. With two defenders in front, they can't dribble or see over to pass, so they have to throw a long, slow pass, and a defender who rotated over can get there in time.
tryit: Trappers: stand hip to hip so there's no gap to split, with your hands high, but don't reach. Everyone else: move toward the ball and guard the closest passing lane.

frames.say: You’re on defense. {1} has the ball on the wing. Red wants {1} to dribble toward the corner.
{X1} stays on the inside, so {1} dribbles down toward the corner.
*Trap!* {X2} leaves {2} and runs over to trap {1} with {X1}. {X3} slides to the middle to guard two players at once.
{1} is stuck, so {1} throws a long, slow pass over to {3}. {X3} gets there in time!
